title.zh: 卷六十六 表第四: 皇族表
title.raw: 卷六十六 表第四: 皇族表 Volume 66 Tables 4: Imperial Family

sentences.zh: ◎皇族表 遼太祖建國，諸弟窺覦，含容誘掖，弗忍致辟，古聖人猶難之。

translations.literal: ◎Imperial Family Table. When Taizu of Liao founded the state, his younger brothers cast covetous eyes upon it; he bore with them, enticed and supported them, and could not bear to execute them—even ancient sages found this difficult.
translations.idiomatic: ◎Imperial Family Table. When the Liao Taizu founded his realm, his younger brothers coveted the throne; he forbearingly harbored them, won them with kindness, and could not bring himself to punish them with death—a dilemma even the sage kings of antiquity found hard to resolve.

sentences.zh: 雖其度量恢廓，然經國之慮遠矣。

translations.literal: Although his magnanimity was vast and accommodating, his forethought in governing the state extended much further.
translations.idiomatic: Magnanimous though he was, his calculations for governing the realm reached far beyond the moment.

sentences.zh: 終遼之世，其出於橫帳、五院、六院之間者，大憝固有，元勛實多。

translations.literal: Throughout the Liao dynasty, among those who came from the Horizontal Tent and from between the Five Courts and Six Courts, great villains indeed existed, but meritorious founding officials were truly many.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the end of the Liao, the lines that sprang from the Horizontal Tent and from the Five and Six Courts produced great villains to be sure, but they also yielded a host of founding meritorious servants.

translations.literal: Unless set forth in a table, one cannot know origins and affiliations.
translations.idiomatic: Without tabular presentation, their origins and lineages would remain unknown.

translations.literal: I therefore compile the 《Imperial Family Table》.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Imperial Family Table》 has therefore been composed.
